the Lord of hosts is his name,
quia non vocaberis ultra domina regnorum.
For you shall no longer be called the noblewoman of kingdoms.
I was angry with my people.
et dedi eos in manu tua:
and I have given them into your hand.
You have not shown mercy to them.
super senem aggravasti jugum tuum valde.
You have greatly increased the burden of your yoke upon the elders.
Non posuisti hæc super cor tuum,
You have not set these things upon your heart,
and you have not remembered your end.
et habitans confidenter, quæ dicis in corde tuo:
you who are delicate and have confidence, who say in your heart:
Ego sum, et non est præter me amplius;
“I am, and there is no one greater than me.
I will not sit as a widow,
and I will not know barrenness.”
Venient tibi duo hæc subito in die una,
These two things will suddenly overwhelm you in one day:
propter multitudinem maleficiorum tuorum, et propter duritiam incantatorum tuorum vehementem.
because of the multitude of your sorceries and because of the great cruelty of your enchantments.
Et fiduciam habuisti in malitia tua,
And you have trusted in your malice,
“There is no one who sees me.”
And you have said in your heart:
et præter me non est altera.
and beside me there is no other.”

et irruet super te calamitas quam non poteris expiare;
And calamity will fall violently over you, and you will not be able to avert it.
veniet super te repente miseria quam nescies.
You will suddenly be overwhelmed by a misery such as you have never known.
and with the multitude of your sorceries,
in quibus laborasti ab adolescentia tua,
in which you have labored from your youth,
as if somehow it might benefit you,
or as if it were able to make you stronger.
You have failed in the multitude of your plans!
those who were contemplating the stars,
ut ex eis annuntiarent ventura tibi.
so that from these they might announce to you the things to come.
Behold, they have become like stubble.
non liberabunt animam suam de manu flammæ;
They will not free themselves from the power of the flames.
These are not coals by which they may be warmed,
nec focus ut sedeant ad eum.
nor is this a fire which they may sit beside.
Sic facta sunt tibi in quibuscumque laboraveras:
So have all these things, in which you have labored,
become to you. Your merchants from your youth,
unusquisque in via sua erraverunt; non est qui salvet te.
each one has erred in his own way. There is no one who can save you.
